tools.purpose: Enumerate which of the five Android pinning layers a package actually declares, so a bypass targets a layer that is present instead of one that was assumed.
tools.expect: one row per pinning layer with the entry or string that proves it, plus which layers are absent

notes: Read-only and offline: it reads zip entries and manifest text, never instrumenting anything. Absent layers are reported as absent rather than guessed, because 'the bypass did nothing' is usually 'the layer was never there'.
